tasks.description: Rename one configuration key across a small TypeScript fixture.
tasks.prompt: In this fixture workspace, rename the configuration key `retryCount` to `maxRetries` in every source and test file. Keep behavior identical and run the fixture's unit tests.

tasks.description: Add one regression test for a described bug.
tasks.prompt: Add a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after it: parsing an empty timeout string must fall back to the documented default.

tasks.description: Diagnose a fixture build failure without changing files.
tasks.prompt: Inspect the fixture build failure and explain the root cause and the smallest safe fix. Do not change files.
